highlights: PLOKAMA CX-60 Neck Bracket for Sports Camera and Smartphone

PLOKAMA CX-60 Neck Bracket for Sports Camera and Smartphone is a hands-free wearable mount designed for capturing stable first-person perspective (POV) footage during daily activities, sports, and travel.
Featuring a magnetic and quick-release mounting system, this neck bracket allows users to securely attach action cameras or smartphones without holding them.
Built with durable silicone, stainless steel, and PC materials, it offers both comfort and strength for long-term use.
With its flexible viewing angle and stable positioning, the PLOKAMA CX-60 Neck Bracket for Sports Camera and Smartphone is ideal for vlogging, cycling, walking, and immersive content creation.
Hands-Free POV Recording Design allows you to capture immersive first-person perspective footage without holding a camera, perfect for active use.
Magnetic & Quick Release Mount System ensures fast, secure attachment and easy removal of devices for convenience during use.
Flexible Viewing Adjustment features an adjustable structure that allows real-time monitoring of your recording angle without removing the device.
Comfortable Neck-Worn Design provides a stable fit around the neck, reducing shake and improving video stability compared to handheld shooting.
Durable Premium Materials made from silicone, stainless steel, and PC for long-lasting performance and resistance to daily wear.
Skin-Friendly Silicone Build ensures comfort during extended use without irritation.
Wide Device Compatibility supports action cameras such as GoPro, Xiaomi Yi, SJCAM, and smartphones with compatible mounts.
